posts.text: It's really exciting to see Tencent put so much effort into safety evaluations before releasing Hy4, and working with a third party evaluator to measure loss of control risks!
posts.quoted: Tencent’s Hy4 system card is out and includes our independent pre-release safety evaluation. It’s the first system card from a Chinese frontier lab, and a meaningful step for third-party evaluation in China. We tested loss-of-control and harmful-manipulation risks with four
